messages.content:
想像一下，你是一位老師，準備在學校舉辦一個以科學和藝術為主題的活動日。你已經為學生們計劃了一系列的活動。首先，你想要把你的30名學生分成小組進行一個團體動力學活動。你知道有15名學生是外向型的，另外15名是內向型的。你能根據這些個性特徵和小組大小來分析這些小組內的社交動態和互動嗎？

接下來，你計劃了一個藝術活動，學生們將會混合兩種主要的顏料顏色。你選擇了藍色和黃色作為這次活動的顏色。如果將亮度調整到70％，你能預測出最終的顏色嗎？

然後，你計劃了一個烹飪活動，學生們將會轉換烹飪的計量單位。你有一個需要2杯麵粉的食譜，但是你的量杯是用毫升來計量的。你能把這個麵粉的計量從杯轉換成毫升嗎？

最後，你計劃了一個物理實驗，學生們將會計算離一個點電荷一定距離處的電場強度。你有一個0.000001庫倫的電荷，想要計算在真空中距離這個電荷0.02公尺處的電場強度。你能幫我計算一下嗎？

function.name: calculate_electric_field_strength
function.description: Calculate the electric field strength at a certain distance from a point charge. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

charge.description: The charge in Coulombs. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance from the charge in meters. This is a float type value.

medium.description: The medium in which the charge and the point of calculation is located. Default is 'vacuum'.

function.name: mix_paint_color
function.description: Combine two primary paint colors and adjust the resulting color's lightness level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

color1.description: The first primary color to be mixed.

color2.description: The second primary color to be mixed.

lightness.description: The desired lightness level of the resulting color in percentage. The default level is set to 50%.

function.name: cooking_conversion_convert
function.description: Convert cooking measurements from one unit to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: group_dynamics_pattern
function.description: Examine the social dynamics and interactions within a group based on the personality traits and group size. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

extroverts.description: The number of extroverted members in the group.

introverts.description: The number of introverted members in the group.
